scope:
Offline spatial analysis of saved local correspondences; no model execution.

Fit orientation-preserving similarity transforms on checkerboard training cells,
score held-out cells, and compare with shuffled reference coordinates. This is
selected-clip exploratory measurement, never a tracking/identity acceptance rule.

method.fit: Orientation-preserving similarity, scale [1/8,8], weighted least-median of 96 deterministic sampled pairs plus least-squares candidate; one lower-half refit.
method.validation: Checkerboard two-fold crossfit, six cells minimum per fold, no acceptance decisions.
method.null: 16 deterministic independent reference-coordinate permutations per frame/anchor/mode; repeat entire fitting procedure. Descriptive baseline, not a calibrated p value.
method.weights: Saved mask coverage only, no similarity or human-label threshold.
method.units: 64x64 feature grid reference cells; 1 cell corresponds to 16 input pixels. Radius 1/2/4 are reported scales, not identity gates.
method.limits: Adjacent train/test cells share encoder context; not independent validation. Deformation, rotation, scale, partial visibility and repeated texture affect fit. Coherent wrong regions can also fit. Selected development frames only.
